newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dywidag sees 96 group net over 40 mln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Dywidag sees 96 group net over 40 mln dmk.

text.p: German construction group Dyckerhoff & Widmann AG (Dywidag) said on Tuesday its 1996 group net profit would probably rise above 40 million marks ($24.1 million) and that dividend payments would follow "accordingly".
The group said total 1996 construction output rose just one percent to 4.12 billion marks during the year, while orders in hand gained 10.8 percent to 3.73 billion marks.
It added that it saw increases in its 1997 output both domestically and in international markets. ($ = 1.662 German Marks)
Dywidag said the economy was not strong enough in 1996 to spur building investment out of its continued slump. It said it expected building investment to fall by at least one percent again in 1997.
It said the sector recession had now also spread to the once-booming east German industry and that business was further affected in 1996 by poor weather.
The company said its staff count fell to 13,354 from 14,564 over the period.
